summary: Iteration 4 (v4: Inbox/Leads, Chat embed, GitHub sync mocked, Export additions, Seed uniqueness, kind selector, AI image btns). 15/15 new backend pytest cases pass in test_v4_inbox_github.py covering: POST /public/contact/{token} creates unread lead visible in per-app + global inbox with app_name; PATCH status read/starred and 400 on invalid status; reply appends replies[] with delivery=email_queued and flips status to read; archive filter and DELETE; POST /public/chat/{token} creates chat lead with 'Visitor:' in body and second turn on same session_id UPSERTS same message (count stays 1) with body 'Visitor:' count == 2; GET /public/embed.js returns application/javascript containing 'embed/chat/'; GET /settings/github disconnected=false after delete; invalid ghp_ token -> 400; POST /apps/{id}/github/push -> status='mocked' with files > 0; autosync toggle persists github_autosync true/false; export/source zip contains site/index.html with 'embed.js', mobile/capacitor.config.json, mobile/README.md; blueprint app app_627d86264eac zip contains app/backend/schema.sql with 'create table'; all 6 seeded apps carry kind (website|app) with distinct theme.primary; seeded Home pages contain navbar+hero(image)+video(url)+gallery blocks; POST /apps with kind='app' stores kind. Frontend: Dashboard header brand 'OmniStack AI' present; kind-filter-app-btn filters cards; new-app-btn modal shows both new-project-kind-website and new-project-kind-app selectors; creating app-kind project navigates to detail and header-kind-chip reads 'App'. On Nexus Commerce: tab-inbox-btn opens inbox-panel with contact rows (2) and chat row (1); clicking row shows inbox-message-body 'Testing contact form v4'; inbox-reply-input + inbox-reply-btn appended reply and toast; inbox-archive-btn moved item into inbox-filter-archived (1 archived row). Handoff tab shows embed-card with embed-snippet containing pv_ token + 'embed.js', embed-copy-btn present, github-card + github-token-input present; github-push-btn triggered mocked push shown in github-last-push ('⚠︎ MOCKED · 12 files'); github-autosync-toggle flipped unchecked -> checked and back. Public /p/<token> renders public-preview-page with orange theme, 7 images, 1 video, chat-widget-fab. preview-page-contact -> contact-form submit shows contact-form-sent. /embed/chat/<token> renders chat-embed-page with chat-widget-fab. Site Mode outline lists 9 blocks; clicking builder-outline-hero-1 exposes ai-image-image-btn (not clicked), builder-outline-gallery-5 exposes ai-image-images-btn. Regression: tab-billing / tab-domain / tab-members all render.

ui_bugs.issue: inbox-unread-count did not decrement after opening an unread contact row (expected 2 -> 1; stayed 2). The optimistic setUnread in patch() checks m.status === 'unread' at call time, but by the time reply/archive fired the local state was inconsistent. Backend correctly persists status=read (verified via pytest). Minor UI counter drift.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: In InboxPanel.jsx, refresh unread count from the server after any patch (or use the returned message's status delta) to keep the unread badge accurate on repeated interactions.
critical_code_review_comments: inbox.py `_new_message` sets `status='unread' if existing['status'] != 'archived' else 'archived'` on chat upsert — good, but the same block updates body with concatenation which grows every visitor turn; the [-8000:] slice can chop mid-line producing partial 'Visitor: ...' entries. Consider storing turns as an array (replies-like) and rendering server-side, or truncate on line boundaries.

github_connect stores the raw PAT in db.settings under key 'github_token' in plaintext. Even for a self-hosted platform this is risky. Encrypt at rest (Fernet with a KEY env var) or store only a scoped app installation token.

InboxPanel.jsx: optimistic setUnread arithmetic is fragile — closes over stale m.status and can double-count (bug already reported). Prefer refetching unread from GET /apps/{id}/inbox after each mutation, or return updated unread in the PATCH response.

public_contact accepts any preview_token but does not rate-limit per token/IP; a spammer can trivially fill db.messages. Add a simple per-token+IP throttle (e.g. 5/min via in-memory or Mongo TTL bucket).

push_to_github: no atomic protection — if repo creation succeeds but tree/commit fails, the user is left with an empty repo. Wrap in try/except and either surface the state or roll back (delete empty repo). Also `slug` derivation may collide across users pushing similarly-named apps.

EMBED_JS is a hardcoded string; the iframe URL uses `s.src`'s origin which is fine, but there is no version/hash for cache-busting. When embed.js is updated, existing customer pages will serve the old cached script until max-age=3600 expires. Consider bumping ?v= or ETag-based validation.

Dashboard.jsx: `newApp.kind` defaults to 'website' but the modal never enforces selection; if user clicks Create without picking, the description text below the buttons still shows both. Cosmetic — set a default highlighted kind and keep it clear.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 app-kind test project 'QA_v4_App_<ts>' via UI (still in DB — safe to delete). Created inbox messages on Nexus Commerce: 'QA Tester' (contact, replied+archived, retained), 'Delete Me' (contact, deleted by test), 'QA V4 Public' (contact from public preview form), plus 1 chat lead with session lead-qa-*. rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Minor UI counter drift in InboxPanel is a stale-closure bug on optimistic state, easily fixed by refetching unread from backend after each PATCH.
